Follows department and facility Policies, Procedures, and Protocols; internal and external, for infection control by wearing proper attire for assigned area and maintain safe work environment by following universal precautions at all times.
Using proper techniques at all times processes and decontaminates instruments and equipment.

Based on department and facility Policies, Procedures, and Protocols; internal and external, inspects, assembles and packages surgical instruments and equipment ensuring items meet end user expectations.
Performs disinfection and sterilization of instruments and equipment, validates and documents appropriate parameters based on Policies, Procedures, and Protocols; internal and external.
Performs routine testing and maintenance on equipment; washing, disinfecting and sterilizing equipment based on Policies, Procedures, and Protocols; internal and external.
Per Policies, Procedures, and Protocols; internal and external, completes all required documentation, communicating to department leader/designee any results not meeting established parameters.

6 months (or when staffing is able to accommodate training, management will consider Instrument Techs who have graduated from an accredited sterile processing program program and completed an externship at Mercy San Juan Central Sterilization Department.
